scripts.title: owehub read desc
scripts.features:
Copy the script.
Paste it into your executor.
Verify on Discord (instructions in the script).
Enjoy easy!

🔥 Main Features
🧠 Brainrot Control:
Refresh Brainrots: Instantly update the list of available Brainrots in the server.
Bring to Me: Teleports selected Brainrot directly to you.
Bring to Brainrot: Teleports you to the selected Brainrot.
🗑️ Delete All Traps: Removes annoying traps locally to make your climb easier.
📍 Teleports
stairs:
Preset Locations: Teleport instantly to key checkpoints:
Basic
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Mythic
Secret
Celestial
Safe Teleport: Optimized coordinates to prevent getting stuck.
🤖 Automation
🔄 Auto Rebirth: Automatically rebirths for you to farm wins.
⏱️ Rebirth Delay: Configurable delay slider for the auto rebirth loop.
🔘 Rebirth Once: Button to manually trigger a single rebirth.
🛠️ Misc & Player
⚡ Instant Pickup: Sets all Proximity Prompts on the map to 0 hold duration for instant interaction.
💰 Sell Inventory: Remotely sells your inventory items.
🏃 WalkSpeed: Adjust your movement speed with a slider (16-500).
🐰 JumpPower: Adjust your jump height with a slider (16-500).
